body:
Based on discussion in #1060, @maizuka made a change to 2.2.4 and 2.2.9 (in #1062).

These now look like this:

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE | [NIST §](https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-3/sp800-63b.html) |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **2.2.4** | [MODIFIED, SPLIT TO 2.2.9] Verify that a hardware-based authenticator and an authenticator that provides verifier impersonation resistance against phishing attacks are used, such as a multi-factor cryptographic hardware, or a combination of a single-factor cryptographic hardware and an OTP device. | | | ✓ | 308 | 5.2.5 |
| **2.2.9** | [ADDED, SPLIT FROM 2.2.4] Verify that multi-factor authentication is required, that is, the application uses either a multi-factor authenticator or a combination of single-factor authenticators. | | ✓ | ✓ | 308 | 4.2.1 |

I like the simplicity of 2.2.9 but I think 2.2.4 is still a little bit clunky. The reason for that seems to be that the NIST guidance is not exactly straightforward but I think the examples we provide are a little confusing.

Also, @RafaelGreen1 suggested in #1287 that we should explicitly mention WebAuthn. 

I think we should reword and simplify 2.2.4 to be:

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE | [NIST §](https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-3/sp800-63b.html) |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **2.2.4** | [MODIFIED, SPLIT TO 2.2.9] Verify that a hardware-based authenticator and an authenticator that provides verifier impersonation resistance against phishing attacks **(such as WebAuthn)** are used. | | | ✓ | 308 | **4.3.1** |

@jmanico what do you think?

comments.body: The following "or a combination of a single-factor cryptographic hardware and an OTP device" does NOT provide phishing resistance. Any OTP can be phished; I'm afraid I have to disagree with the wording on 2.2.4 because of this.

Hi @jmanico,

I think this the reason that I suggested the following wording (which explicitly requires phishing resistance) for the requirement:

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE | [NIST §](https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-3/sp800-63b.html) |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **2.2.4** | [MODIFIED, SPLIT TO 2.2.9] Verify that a hardware-based authenticator and an authenticator that provides verifier impersonation resistance against phishing attacks **(such as WebAuthn)** are used. | | | ✓ | 308 | 4.3.1 |

Is this updated wording ok?
